Video name: Which US state is called the "Sunshine State"?
column7: Florida has the longest coastline of the 48 mainland US states.

Video name: Silicon Valley is in which US state?
column7: It is named after the silicon chips used in computers. Apple and Google are based there.

Video name: Hollywood, the home of American films, is in which city?
column7: The famous sign first said HOLLYWOODLAND when it was put up in 1923.

Video name: Which US President issued the Emancipation Proclamation to free slaves?
column7: Abraham Lincoln issued it in 1863. He was the 16th President of the USA.

Video name: How many stripes are on the US flag?
column7: The 13 stripes stand for the 13 original colonies. The 50 stars stand for the states.

Video name: Which famous waterfall lies on the border of the USA and Canada?
column7: Niagara Falls is really three waterfalls: Horseshoe Falls, American Falls and Bridal Veil Falls.

Video name: Which US city is known as the birthplace of jazz music?
column7: The famous jazz trumpeter Louis Armstrong was born in New Orleans in 1901.

Video name: Which American was the first person to walk on the Moon?
column7: Neil Armstrong stepped onto the Moon on 20 July 1969 during the Apollo 11 mission.

Video name: What is the name of the US national anthem?
column7: Francis Scott Key wrote the words in 1814. It became the national anthem in 1931.

Video name: The city of Las Vegas is in which US state?
column7: Las Vegas is in the Mojave Desert and is famous for its bright lights and shows.
